title: You Read Labels. We Write Ones Worth Reading.
descriptionHtml:
You read labels. We write ones worth reading.

FORTIFIED® is functional hydration and supplements built on radical transparency. Every milligram disclosed. No proprietary blends. No fillers you can't pronounce. No fear-mongering. Just real ingredients in honest amounts — that is the whole promise.

  • Everyday Hydration with D3 + K2 — caffeine-free daily electrolytes built on Pink Himalayan Salt, magnesium malate, and real coconut water, plus Vitamin D3 (130% DV) and K2 as MK-7.
  • Energy with Natural Caffeine — the same clean electrolyte base with 152mg of caffeine from real coffee bean. No caffeine anhydrous, no crash.
  • Creatine Monohydrate — single-ingredient, the way it should be. No additives, no proprietary blend, no anti-caking junk.

Sweetened with monk fruit and fermented Reb M. Made in the USA in a cGMP-compliant facility, third-party tested. No Mumbo Jumbo.

* These statements have not been evaluated by the FDA. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

title: Hydration Powders by FORTIFIED®
descriptionHtml:
Real minerals. Honest amounts. Hydration worth reading the label for.

Two clean electrolyte mixes built on the same transparent base — 1,210mg sodium from Pink Himalayan Salt, 150mg magnesium malate, 220mg potassium from real coconut water, and 1,940mg chloride in every stick pack. Sweetened with monk fruit and fermented Reb M — never sugar, never sucralose, never aspartame.

Pick Everyday for caffeine-free daily hydration with added Vitamin D3 (130% DV) and Vitamin K2 as MK-7. Pick Energy for 152mg of natural caffeine from real coffee bean — the same clean base, with a clean lift. Both come in Salty Orange and Salty Watermelon. 30 stick packs per pouch. Made in the USA in a cGMP-compliant facility, third-party tested.

title: Supplements by FORTIFIED®
descriptionHtml:
Single ingredient. Nothing else.

Honest supplements for people who actually read the label. Right now that means FORTIFIED® Creatine Monohydrate — just creatine, dosed honestly, with nothing else in the pouch. No fillers, no proprietary blends, no anti-caking junk, nothing you have to Google at 11pm.

Creatine monohydrate is one of the most studied supplements on the planet. We did not reinvent it. We just gave it a label you can actually trust. Made in the USA in a cGMP-compliant facility, third-party tested.
